legacy_star_sailors.description: Original Star Sailors client/game collections. Names are frozen for compatibility with the current app and existing migrated data.

platform_shared.description: Cross-product identity and service-to-service data owned by the shared backend.

atlas.description: New Atlas citizen-science product collections owned by the shared backend.

other_product.description: Product-specific data belongs in that product's PocketBase spoke, not in the legacy Star Sailors instance.

policy: Do not rename legacy_star_sailors collections without a compatibility migration and an app-wide query update.
Do not add new unprefixed collections to the legacy Star Sailors instance.
Do not add Atlas or other product collections to the legacy Star Sailors instance.
A collection that is used by one product's gameplay belongs to that product's spoke; only genuinely cross-product data belongs on the shared backend.
